name: ui-kit
title: UI kit: design taste, modern web platform, UI behaviors, prototypes
note: impeccable is the single source of visual direction (init/document/polish/critique/audit); modern-web-guidance provides Baseline/modern HTML, CSS, and client-side JS best practices; ui-sdk covers accessible UI behaviors and components across React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and web components; prototype answers design questions with throwaway code.
